about.en: DIMO is the token of the DIMO Network, an open protocol for connected vehicles in which each registered car gets an on-chain identity tied to its VIN and its owner grants and revokes scoped data access to applications. DIMO is used for protocol rewards, staking and payment of network fees. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x5fab9761d60419c9eeebe3915a8fa1ed7e8d2e1b, with the DIMO Foundation's bridged deployment on Polygon at 0xe261d618a959afffd53168cd07d12e37b26761db.
